name: Dublin
description: From neighborhood parks to city budgets, local decisions help shape daily life in Dublin.
government: Dublin uses a council–manager form of government: elected leaders set direction, and an appointed city manager oversees daily operations.

roles.title: Mayor
roles.description: An elected member of the City Council who provides political leadership alongside the council.

roles.title: City Council
roles.description: Sets local policy and makes decisions about the city’s priorities and public resources.

roles.title: City Manager
roles.description: Appointed by the council to oversee day-to-day city operations and carry out its direction.

meeting.location: Peter W. Snyder Council Chamber · 100 Civic Plaza

name: San Ramon
description: Discover the people and public meetings behind decisions in your San Ramon community.
government: San Ramon uses a council–manager form of government. The mayor and four councilmembers set policy; the city manager runs daily operations.

roles.title: Mayor
roles.description: Chairs council meetings and represents the city. The mayor has the same voting authority as other councilmembers.

roles.title: City Council
roles.description: Establishes policy, adopts the annual budget, and appoints the city manager.

roles.title: City Manager
roles.description: Oversees daily operations and coordinates city services to carry out council policies.

meeting.agendaStatus: Current meeting subjects have not been verified in CivicLab. Open the official agenda portal and select a City Council meeting to see its topics.

participation: Review the agenda to see which topics will be discussed.
Check current public-comment procedures before attending; the city’s guide explains speaker cards.
Use the official council page to find representatives and contact information.
